title: Fulfilling food experience
text:
Wonderful! After a brief intro to Barcelona, Alf took us to our first restaurant, asked about allergies, and our preferences. We sampled several dishes and beverages. We went to a second awesome restaurant for different plates and beverages. Our third stop was for churros for dessert.

Alfs goal was that we finished the tour neither hungry or thirsty!
author: brian_b

title: Tapas tout
text:
Alan was so informative pleasant lots of fun anyone who has them as a tour guide would be lucky
The best ever
author: Vicki_B

title: Barcelona Food Tour
text: Frederico accommodated my family (8 people) needs and provided a wonderful evening, with some history mixed in.  The tapas and dessert were an authentic Barcelona experience, enjoyed by all.
author: Virginia_B

title: Fun in a historic town
text: Alan was a fountain of historical knowledge. He gave us some insights into the history and culture of Barcelona that was easy and fun to assimilate. The spots he took us were fun to navigate and the food along the way was wonderful. Highly recommend Alan and the tour of the gothic old town area as well as the stops along the way.
author: Viral_J

title: Great Fun!
text: Alan was very fun and personable. His knowledge and love of Barcelona and its food was evident from the start and we enjoyed our time on this tour very much!
author: Lauren_J

title: Fabulous food with a side of history!
text: Allen was an excellent tour guide on this Tappas adventure.  The food he selected was delicious and truly things I would never have selected for myself.  But even better than the food was his knowledge of the history of Barcelona and Spain.  We so enjoyed the walk around the area and learned so much.  The day ended perfectly with the best churro’s made fresh in front of us!
author: Mary_R

title: The market is a must see!
text: The market was the best part of the tour. Our guide was knowledgeable about the entire region. Highly recommended!
author: Margaret_P

title: Great personalized tour
text: Jonathan was great and tailored the tour around our interests. The food was delicious and had a great variety.
author: Diana_R

title: Great Tour, Alf is your go to guide!
text: The tapas tour was a phenomenal experience, walking the city while hearing its rich history and of course, the tapas and drinks were adored by all! The best part of the tour was our guide Alf, you couldn’t ask for a better guide and person!!
author: Patricia_W

title: Like walking with a friend, not a tour guide.
text: Johnathan showed us everything he could with the limited time he had. Walking with him was like walking with an old friend who is showing you around the new neighbor you just moved into. Great sights to see! Great little spots to check out!  I’d love to spend a weekend in Barcelona just to see what else he’s got!
author: mike_m
